integrity: The trichotomy is proved analytically from the rank-one positive-semidefinite cone in Pauli coordinates. The full-phase-retrieval branch is explicitly identified as a specialization of an earlier global kernel criterion; the claimed additional contribution is the exact almost-everywhere boundary and generic fiber multiplicity. Finite checks are supplementary only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies exactly three arbitrary Hermitian measurements in complex dimension two. It does not classify higher-dimensional minimal systems, and additional positivity or POVM constraints may restrict which kernel types can occur.
title: Three Hermitian measurements in \(\mathbb C^2\): an exact Lorentz-cone trichotomy
